maintenance_enabled.description: Flip to true to broadcast a blocking announcement dialog to every user on launch (outages, SIS down, API issues, emergency notice, etc). Pair with `maintenance_message` for the body text.

qpapers_enabled.description: Master switch for the Previous Year Question Papers tile + flow. Gated to 2025+ batches client-side; admins always see the tile. Flip false for instant kill-switch (hides tile + blocks browse/upload).

ads_enabled.description: Master switch for AdMob banners and interstitials. Keep false until the app is live on Google Play and the AdMob app is linked to the Play listing (required for certified traffic + higher eCPM).

sideload_block_enabled.description: When true, non-Play-Store installs of v2.2+ are hard-blocked on launch with a dialog linking to the Play listing. Flip to true after the app is live on Play + AdMob is linked, to migrate sideloaded users to certified traffic. Debug builds always bypass.

chess_backend_v2.description: Cloudflare Durable Objects chess lobby. Worker rehydrates the players map from state.getWebSockets() on wake (fixed 2026-05-05). Flip false for instant rollback to Firestore.

maintenance_message.description: Body text shown in the maintenance dialog when `maintenance_enabled` is true. Empty defaults to a generic maintenance message. Edit freely to re-use as a generic announcement channel.

announcement_active.description: Dashboard dismissable announcement dialog. When true and announcement_id/message are set, shows once per user until they tap Got it (tracked by announcement_id).

announcement_id.description: Unique id for the current announcement. Change this to re-prompt users who dismissed a previous announcement.

defaultValue.value: A quick note from the dev

announcement_title.description: Title of the dashboard announcement dialog.

defaultValue.value:

I've seen all the issue reports and feature requests — rest assured I'm reading them. Right now I'm in placement season, so I can't ship fixes as fast as usual.

Once I get placed, I'll come back and work through everything — tentatively around November.

Thank you, and happy using!
